description: This code defines an Android Fragment named LogFragment which contains a LogView used to display log data. It inflates a view hierarchy with a ScrollView containing a customizable, monospace LogView, and manages the auto-scrolling of logs when the text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log in a scrollable view, auto-scrolling as new log entries are appended.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view hierarchy and sets up a text watcher to auto-scroll the log.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used to display logs.
